title: Parking Attendants
description: Park vehicles or issue tickets for customers in a parking lot or garage. May park or tend vehicles in environments such as a car dealership or rental car facility. May collect fee.

tasks.text: Take numbered tags from customers, locate vehicles, and deliver vehicles, or provide customers with instructions for locating vehicles.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person comfort and safety assurance

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Inspect vehicles to detect any damage.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vehicle inspection is physical on-site work

tasks.text: Greet customers and open their car doors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person comfort and safety assurance

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Issue ticket stubs or place numbered tags on windshields, log tags or attach tag to customers' keys, and give customers matching tags for locating parked vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically applying labels requires hands

tasks.text: Perform cash handling tasks, such as making change, balancing and recording cash drawer, or distributing tips.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Balancing receipts is arithmetic, human handles discrepancies

dwas.name: Prepare cash for deposit or disbursement.

tasks.text: Explain and calculate parking charges, collect fees from customers, and respond to customer complaints.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Collecting fares physically from customers

dwas.name: Collect fares or payment from customers.

tasks.text: Park and retrieve automobiles for customers in parking lots, storage garages, or new car lots.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving passenger vehicles needs real-world control

dwas.name: Drive passenger vehicles.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Provide customer assistance and information, such as giving directions or handling wheelchairs.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Keep parking areas clean and orderly to ensure that space usage is maximized.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and work areas

tasks.text: Call emergency responders or the proper authorities and provide motorist assistance, such as giving directions or helping jump start a stalled vehicle.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency request requires live accountable action

dwas.name: Request emergency personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Patrol parking areas to prevent vehicle damage and vehicle or property thefts.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Hazard detection in surroundings needs embodied sensing

dwas.name: Monitor surroundings to detect potential hazards.

tasks.text: Direct motorists to parking areas or parking spaces, using hand signals or flashlights as necessary.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Directing live traffic requires physical presence

tasks.text: Escort customers to their vehicles to ensure their safety.
Perform maintenance on cars in storage to protect tires, batteries, or exteriors from deterioration.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Lift, position, and remove barricades to open or close parking areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of materials and supplies
